decision_experiments.current_owned_result: rev0378 adds the missing reference-stable whole-code criterion. For a target algebra A, the executable REF-0736 bridge uses delta_A=||Nhat-Nhat o P_{A'}||_diamond and delta_A^2/4<=E_A<=2 sqrt(delta_A). Target recovery error 0.1 requires delta_A<=0.0025; under only the generic d_code-dimensional lift, a state-only error must be <=0.0025/d_code. A sharp CPTP transpose-dephasing family has state envelope 2/(d+1) but exact delta_A=(d-1)/(d+1), so at d=4096 the unassisted error is 0.000488162069807176 while delta_A is 0.999511837930193 and E_A remains at least 0.249755978540648. An erasure-channel control independently gives one common decoder with exact delta_A=E_A=2p(1-1/d^2). The rev0377 Condition-2 routing and coherent-sector parameter split remain intact.
decision_experiments.owned_result_scope: Owned finite-dimensional theorem translation and stress tests only. REF-0735 Condition 1 is state-level; this revision does not prove that epsilon_OD, epsilon_sub-tr, or their combination controls the same complementary map in diamond/cb norm with an external reference. A physical result must provide that direct bound or explicit d_code/reference growth whose rate pays the state-to-diamond lift, on the same region, target algebra, channel, and domain as the dominant-block decoders and center/factor errors. Physical G/N scaling, constants, backreaction, islands, non-AdS transport, and public records remain unpaid. Computational dimensions remain unmapped. Authority remains S3.
